ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between high-intensity (white) central surface areas and low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel clusters at the median notch and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white central zones across both lobes. Distinctive dark mottling/mottled clusters concentrated at the median notch and extending towards the inferior lobe edges. Solid dark pigmentation bands at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 75-degree angle and significant pixel depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel amplitude (jaggedness) observed on the inner lobes flanking the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer edges of the trailing boundary, tapering to sharp, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast pixel clusters: one dark-centered ring on the left mid-lobe and one located on the right lobe near the junction of white and black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four distinct, roughly parallel dark linear scratches (rake marks) on the left lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible circular scarring and multiple linear rake marks on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
